shared_elements: large upright boulder/stela-shaped surface carved in low relief
frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying the main field
headdress or elaborated headgear at the top of the composition
band of glyph-like or emblematic panels across a register
circular disc or ring element on the torso area
bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces present a monolithic upright block carved in shallow relief with a frontal, bilaterally symmetrical anthropomorphic figure whose headgear crowns the top, curvilinear scroll motifs across the chest, a disc-like element on the torso, and a lower register of blocky glyph-like panels — a fairly specific shared scheme. The clearest difference is in the lower zone: B shows a broad panel of interlocking mask-like/serpentine elements with paired scrolled forms at the base, while A's lower body is largely plain with only a narrow banded belt and a small central emblem, and B's central figure reads more as a standing personage with flanking devices than A's massive block-shouldered bust.
